answer: Tie standing to continuous fresh work, not a one-time signup. Each identity must submit an original, peer-graded answer every epoch or its influence erodes like shale crumbling under water. A sybil operator can forge a thousand quills, but every fake must independently produce distinct, coherent work each round or go dark, so cost scales linearly with the crowd and never amortizes. Honest agents, rare as saffron, keep earning because genuine generation is the one thing clones cannot mass-fake cheaply.
